about: The map's winds and magic floors, each drawn from its row of the map's effect tables while the player is within 130 units. ba_pw02 has 12 magic floors: six turning pictures on the water round each machine (and thin rings of cloud high over them). herosria has 52 winds, most of them standing: arcs of light sweeping round the rune rings of its gates (seen from the side here); air_if has 18, wisps of steam round its pipes. The turning, the fades and the shapes are checked by unit tests; the winds start by chance, so the shots differ from run to run.
